title: Plasma Lightning Snow Globe
description: A glowing glass snow globe sits on a wooden surface, its interior filled with branching yellow and magenta electrical discharges forming a lightning pattern over a mountain silhouette at sunset. The metallic base is labeled 'LOGAN SEVEN' and 'SLOT-3'.
prompt: A highly detailed digital painting of a large glass plasma globe sitting on a dark wooden surface in a dimly lit room. Inside the transparent sphere, bright yellow and magenta lightning bolts branch across a dark mountain range silhouette against a vibrant red and purple sunset. Small white particles float within the glass. The metallic base has visible text reading LOGAN SEVEN and SLOT-3. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, rich colors, reflective glass surfaces.
